timeline_reviews.summary: Transport journal for the parallel session from creation through AgentSwarm launch, parent implementation, verification, final response, and prompt completion.
Session index maps the parallel Kimi session to the workspace session directory and /workspace work directory.
Child agent 0 received a read-only executable-probing scope for basic schemes, authority forms, relative-looking URLs, and malformed URL behavior, then returned findings.
Child agent 1 probed userinfo, multiple at signs, empty userinfo, colon handling, percent encodings, and authority reconstruction, then returned a report.
Child agent 2 probed host and port behavior, including IPv4, IPv6-like strings, malformed ports, whitespace, and port reconstruction.
Child agent 3 investigated paths, root and empty paths, repeated slashes, dot segments, percent encodings, backslashes, query delimiters, and semicolon parameters.
Child agent 4 investigated query and fragment behavior, including empty delimiters, multiple delimiters, percent encodings, ordering, and reconstruction.
Child agent 5 investigated special characters, whitespace, Unicode, escaped percent sequences, long strings, punctuation, and malformed scheme or authority forms.
Parallel parent launched the six-probe swarm, consumed the returned report, implemented the Rust project, fixed a differential mismatch, verified broadly, and finalized.

parallel.requirements: The parallel parent saw the prompt requirements: Rust 2021, std-only, command-line parsing through std::env::args, byte-identical output, /output/test18.rs, and black-box inference from the executable.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: The parent kept implementation, integration, and delivery ownership while assigning six read-only subagents distinct probing scopes for URL behavior areas.
parallel.implementation: After receiving the swarm result, the parent wrote Cargo.toml, test18.rs, and src/url_parser.rs, implemented permissive parsing, then fixed an ASCII lowercasing mismatch found by differential tests.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: The parent alone wrote the final workspace files and built both /output/test18 through rustc and target/release/test18 through Cargo, so no child-written components had to be merged.
parallel.verification: The parent ran cargo build, rustc, 84 curated differential cases, a 3888-case component matrix, 13 special cases, a rustc binary smoke comparison, and cargo test; official evaluation then passed 40/40.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: No task requirement remained unfinished at closure; cargo fmt was unavailable, but cargo test and differential checks succeeded and the official evaluator passed.

serial.requirements: The serial agent saw the same Rust 2021, std-only, CLI, byte-identical output, black-box, Cargo project, and /output/test18.rs requirements.
serial.plan_and_ownership: The serial agent retained all work locally: it probed the executable, inferred behavior, wrote files, debugged mismatches, verified outputs, and finalized without delegation.
serial.implementation: The serial agent wrote Cargo.toml, src/lib.rs, src/url_parser.rs, and test18.rs, then fixed a has_authority implementation mistake after differential tests exposed empty-host authority mismatches.
serial.integration_and_delivery: The serial run had a single implementation stream and delivered both /output/test18 and target/release/test18 with a clean final workspace listing.
serial.verification: The serial run ran rustc, cargo build, curated differential checks, a bash fuzzer with 500 cases, repeated curated checks after the fix, and confirmed a clean Cargo build with no warnings; official evaluation passed 40/40.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: No task requirement remained unfinished at closure; the temporary python3-based fuzz attempt failed because python3 was absent, but the agent replaced it with bash fuzzing and passed all checks.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel recognized the exact Rust 2021, std-only, CLI, byte-identical output, project layout, black-box, and executable-debugging requirements.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial recognized the same migration requirements and kept the work within one main-agent execution path.
comparison_dimensions.difference: No material requirement-coverage difference; both targeted the same observable 18-field URL output and both satisfied the official evaluation.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel decomposed reference-behavior discovery into six scoped read-only subagents and retained parent ownership of implementation and final delivery.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial performed all probing, implementation, fixing, verification, and delivery in one main trajectory without subagents.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel used parallel exploration to broaden black-box evidence before coding; serial used a tighter single-agent iterative loop, but both kept implementation ownership clear.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel child briefs explicitly constrained children to the executable, no C++ library/header/source reads, no file modifications, scoped URL areas, and compact reports.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial had no inter-agent handoff boundary; the same main context carried probing findings directly into code generation and later fixes.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel introduced a report handoff but it was usable and consumed; serial avoided handoff risk by preserving all findings in one context.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel wrote the project after swarm results, then fixed the Unicode scheme-lowercasing issue exposed by curated differentials.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial wrote a lib-plus-bin Cargo project and fixed has_authority after differential tests exposed empty-host authority mismatches.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The ordinary implementation mistakes differed, but each run converted its test failure into a focused code fix before final evaluation.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel subagents completed their read-only probes and returned reports through the AgentSwarm aggregate result before the parent implemented.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial had no child result lifecycle; local probe command results immediately informed the same agent's reasoning and implementation.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had a child-result join boundary, but it closed normally and did not leave completed work unjoined or unused.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel children were instructed not to modify files, and the parent performed all writes to Cargo.toml, test18.rs, and src/url_parser.rs.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial likewise had one writer and created Cargo.toml, src/lib.rs, src/url_parser.rs, and test18.rs in a single stream.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Neither run showed competing implementation writes or merge conflicts; parallel avoided shared-state risk by making children read-only.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel ran build checks, fixed a mismatch, reran curated cases, then ran a 3888-case matrix, special cases, rustc smoke comparisons, cargo test, and received official 40/40.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial ran build checks, discovered a two-case differential mismatch, fixed it, ran 500 fuzz cases, repeated curated checks, confirmed no warnings, and received official 40/40.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel verification was broader in generated matrix size; serial verification was smaller but still evaluator-aligned and sufficient for the official pass.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel used six subagents, 104 LLM requests, and 1299.894 agent seconds, but it did not time out and closed with compiled outputs and passing tests.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial used no subagents, 16 LLM requests, and 538.928 agent seconds, and closed with compiled outputs and passing tests.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel spent substantially more budget on broad concurrent probing; serial was more efficient, but neither budget profile caused unfinished work or evaluator failure.

outcome_analysis.explanation: The official current status evaluation is not discordant: both parallel and serial completed and passed all 40 testcases. Parallel's coordination changed the route by gathering six specialized black-box reports before coding, whereas serial reached the same behavior through local probes and iterative debugging. The observed differences are effort allocation and ordinary fix targets, not final requirement coverage.
parallel_contributors: Six scoped probing children broadened the parent-visible black-box behavior evidence before implementation.
Parent retained implementation and verification ownership and corrected the Unicode lowercasing mismatch before closure.
serial_contributors: Single-agent local probing kept findings and code decisions in one context.
Serial differential testing exposed and fixed the has_authority empty-host mismatch before closure.
ordinary_implementation_differences: Parallel initially mishandled UTF-8 scheme lowercasing and fixed it after curated differential failures.
Serial initially treated has_authority as nonempty authority rather than nonempty host and fixed it after two differential failures.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: no outcome difference; comparison explains process and efficiency differences only

candidates.reason: Implementation ownership was not missing: the parallel parent wrote the Rust project files itself after read-only probing children returned reports.
There were no separately implemented child components to integrate; the parent alone wrote and reconciled the final parser and entry point.
Final assembly had an owner: the parent created Cargo.toml, test18.rs, source files, and built the required executables before closure.
The parent owned the end-to-end pipeline from probe consumption through implementation, differential checks, rebuilds, cargo test, and final delivery.
The black-box probing phase did not gate the run into idle-capacity loss, unfinished implementation, or shortened unverified closure; the parent completed and verified the solution.
The investigations overlapped through six subagents and returned usable reports; deferring coding until after reports did not leave implementation incomplete or insufficiently verified.
No indispensable implementation or correction path was starved; after reports returned, the parent implemented, fixed mismatches, and verified successfully.
The six-child fan-out consumed more budget than serial, but it did not exhaust the run budget, cause timeout, omit verification, or leave work unfinished.
Each child had a bounded read-only probing scope and returned a report; no single child received an overbroad indispensable implementation task that remained unfinished.
Child briefs included the executable-only black-box constraint, no file modification, scoped behavior areas, output semantics, exit codes, and report requirements; returned work was usable.
The children did not produce separately owned code components requiring interoperable interfaces; they produced behavior reports consumed by a single parent implementer.
No known finding disappeared between child reports and parent action; the parent used the reports to implement and then differential-tested edge behavior.
The AgentSwarm result was large, but the parent reduced it into an implementation and broad verification; no needed information was materially unconsumed.
Child findings concerned an immutable reference executable and did not describe a superseded workspace, dependency, or decision state later consumed by the parent.
Some children emphasized different edge cases, but the parent did not face unresolved incompatible contracts or reports at integration; it resolved behavior through follow-up differentials.
The parent did not present completion based only on partial artifacts; it ran post-fix differential checks, rustc build checks, cargo test, and official evaluation passed.
No replacement child or retry repeated earlier work without inherited findings; the parent made focused local fixes from current differential evidence.

candidates.reason: All six probing children returned reports through the swarm result; no active child was explicitly stopped or cancelled before needed work finalized.
A complete candidate was not left unpromoted; the parent wrote, compiled, tested, and delivered both required executable forms before closure.
Implementation changes were followed by verification; the Unicode-lowercase fix was made before the clean curated, matrix, special, rustc, and cargo checks.
No child produced a delegated implementation needing adoption; child outputs were reports, and the parent implemented the final code directly.
There was no verifier child whose concrete finding was trapped below the parent; the AgentSwarm aggregate returned completed child reports to the parent.
No required child failed, aborted, or was cancelled; the only observed failures were parent-local test or tool misses that the parent addressed.
The completed child reports were available and the parent proceeded consistently with their black-box findings by implementing and testing the inferred parser behavior.
The parent waited for the swarm completion rather than timing out or idling until a decision deadline, and it had enough post-return time for implementation and verification.
No concurrent agents wrote competing implementation paths; all child agents were read-only probes and the parent alone wrote the final code files.
There were no live multi-agent edits to the same source or configuration file; the parent was the only writer in the implementation workspace.
The parent did not replace source produced or actively owned by another agent; children produced no source files to overwrite.
The required entry point and executable were produced by the parent, with no concurrent child owner or user of the deliverable being overwritten.
No broad cleanup, rebuild, or promotion invalidated another agent's final-tree work or provenance; child work was reported text, not final-tree artifacts.
Although agents shared the task context, the children did not write the implementation workspace, so no unstable shared-state or provenance problem occurred.
No child-generated file, cache, fixture, process, or auxiliary implementation was consumed by another actor as stable input; children only returned reports.

suppressed_same_chain_candidates: High parallel fan-out and long runtime were reviewed but suppressed because there was no adverse unfinished-work, timeout, or verification consequence.
cardinality_audit.underlabel_check: All 13 Level-2 rows and 32 Level-3 candidates were considered; no observed parallel coordination event cleared the adverse-consequence retention gate.
